name: Check feature accessibility
description: Call this when you need to determine whether a specific UI feature flag is enabled for the current user. If you only need to know the static configuration of a feature, use the application’s built‑in configuration view instead.

source.description: The source of the feature flag request, typically "unleash".

feature.description: The name of the feature flag to check, e.g., "contact-summary-rollout".

outputs.description: A map where the key is the requested feature name and the value is a boolean indicating whether the feature is enabled.
